Unsupervised and Interpretable Machine Learning for Label-Free Neonatal Phenotyping and Risk Assessment

Lina Farouk, Rina Das

Abstract. Neonatal intensive care units generate rich physiological data, yet most risk tools need labelled outcomes. We clustered 12,000 admissions without labels and found five interpretable phenotypes.

6 Conclusion

Label-free clustering found clinically meaningful neonatal phenotypes, and two of them flagged high sepsis risk within six hours of admission.
